one_liners: NISAR sends its first Earth images (30 September) — the NASA-ISRO Synthetic Aperture Radar satellite's inaugural imagery as it readies for full operations.
ICC Women's ODI World Cup 2025 begins (30 September) — co-hosted by India and Sri Lanka.
